assignments.reason: נשפך דמו (his blood is shed) is essentially identical in nature to שפיכות דמים (shedding of blood) already in Package 4. The proof text states 'עַל־יְדֵי הַבּוּשָׁה נִשְׁפָּךְ דָּמוֹ' — through shame his blood is shed. This is the same redemptive blood-shedding-through-shame that defines Package 4's domain of atonement. It belongs here by essential nature: the spilling of blood as spiritual purification, not by its causal connection to shame.
